mostWorthwhile.text: The water comparison was most worthwhile: matching the starting conditions and interval made the aquaporin’s effect on exchange rate distinct from the direction of net movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing each channel was somewhat repetitive, although both preparations made their membrane location clear.

surprise.text: The lipid-only patch allowed water to cross in both directions; the aquaporin increased exchange rather than creating the only possible route.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. Inspecting phospholipids initially led automatically to assembly, and its purpose became clear in the bilayer picture.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose another chapter: the matched transport comparisons made the constructions informative, and I would be curious to see how later structures build on them.
